Construct · SM +1 Retriever (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5)

A headless oval of black iron on four long walking legs, with four shorter scythe arms folded against the body and mandibles set in the front rim. It is a hunting machine built to fetch one named thing, it does not stop, and it cannot be reasoned with because there is nothing in it to reason with.
